parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, forming the outer structural shell that supports all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity, protection, and structural integrity to the dishwasher, ensuring stability during operation.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is a fixed, non-moving part that holds other components in place.

parts.name: Body Interior
parts.Basic_description: The body interior of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, forming the inner cavity where dishes are placed for cleaning.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the racks, spray arms, and water jets, and is designed to withstand high temperatures and moisture during washing cycles.
parts.Movement_description: The interior body is stationary but interacts with moving parts like racks and spray arms.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel and serves as the main access point to the interior.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the dishwasher during operation to prevent water leakage and provides a control interface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about a bottom hinge, allowing it to open downward and close securely with a latch mechanism.
